neutral_component_scope: Start with the base-named module, package entry and utilities-named file, plus signal/context-named tests. Actual APIs and relationships remain unexamined.

scope_limits.closure: Later confirm API declarations, immediate helper/caller relationships, supported interpreter/configuration boundaries and relevant requirement evidence.

goal: Later bounded source-grounded verification/specification assessment of this filename-defined Python-library slice; actionable handoff or no-new-work without predetermined properties.
adoption: Read-only planning only; no target production changes or execution without separate actual owner grants and applicable isolation.

license_locators: LICENSE.txt copyright, permission, notice and disclaimer paragraphs
provenance.license_interpretation: Primary API MIT identification agrees with inspected root license text.

uncertainties: Semantic version, Python range, dependencies, concurrency, async use, FFI and deployment applicability unexamined.
Signal/context test names do not establish behavior or existing coverage.
Repository creation date establishes age of GitHub identity, not quality or suitability.
Catalog membership and assessment outcome unexamined.
identity_basis: Pinned Git commit/tree plus independently clean working tree and tracked object inventory; not a SHA-256 digest of every working-tree file
